skill.summary: Add new functionality to untested legacy code using Sprout Method, Sprout Class, Wrap Method, or Wrap Class — whichever best fits the dependency profile. Use...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Introduces a new skill for safely and quickly adding features to untested legacy code using Sprout Method, Sprout Class, Wrap Method, or Wrap Class techniques.
- Guides developers to select the least-invasive approach based on dependency complexity and whether the new behavior must co-execute with existing code (temporal coupling).
- Provides clear prerequisites, step-by-step process, and contextual cues for when and how to apply each technique.
- Designed for time-pressured scenarios where legacy code can’t be easily tested or refactored.
- Draws directly from "Working Effectively with Legacy Code" (Chapter 6) and integrates with related skills for legacy editing discipline.
